item.description: Chrysnikos #4263 the Blood-handed fell at Neokrates #8048's feet and clasped their knees, as Priam clasped Achilles'. Neokrates #8048 raised them up. The blood between them is set aside.

item.description: The oracle given to Alkmedes #6152 came to nothing: "When the boneless one climbs the mast, look to your own house." Or it came true in some way nobody has noticed yet. Phaiddotos #8798 is not consulted as often.

item.description: The story has changed in the telling. In Lemnos they now say: "They say the field at Lemnos ran with marrow. The augurs say it was foretold."

item.description: Demias #906 of the House of Pelorus fell (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Lemnos). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend. Demias is the bone-breaker now.

item.title: The seer Agathstratos #1400 looked at Chrysdoros #5112's house in the Field of Ares and cr
item.description: The seer Agathstratos #1400 looked at Chrysdoros #5112's house in the Field of Ares and cried out: the walls drip blood, the porch is full of ghosts going down to the dark, the sun has perished from heaven. The household laughed with jaws not their own.

item.title: A beggar knocked at Diphon Archnikidis ~261's door in Anthemoessa and was fed. In the morn
item.description: A beggar knocked at Diphon Archnikidis ~261's door in Anthemoessa and was fed. In the morning the beggar was gone, and 209 obols were under the bowl. The beggar was Archon #3999 the Twice-Born, of the Golden Race.
